sensitivity_notice: 20A step threshold evaluated after 10A main result; retained and compared on common held systems, not replacement blind confirmation
outer_split: leave physical 8S system out; only systems with at least 100 retained 3h step events and >=30 calendar days scored
target_online_prefix: first 20% of selected step events per cell warms time filter; later 80% one-step-ahead score, updating only after observation
train_cap_rule: chronological evenly-spaced complete pack step events; all eight cells kept
adaptive_workpoint_added_after_v4: v4 constant+time beat RBF+time; v5 tests whether target-prefix online slope calibration rescues operating-point model, while retaining all v4 controls

adaptive_workpoint.state: offset plus four slopes for normalized I, SOC, T, deltaI

matched_temporal_controls_added_after_v3: v3 revealed RBF-only worse than constant; v4 retains v3 and adds constant+time and linear+time with identical warmup/filter settings to isolate spatial contribution

spatial_kernel.center_selection: deterministic farthest-point from 10000 pooled training events

time_filter.type: per_system_cell Brownian random-walk Kalman filter of residual

claim_limit: Step response at 5s cadence includes polarization, BMS SOC is not capacity truth; model is a low-dimensional BattGP-inspired approximation, not exact paper reproduction.
